data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season—and to look after our neighbors. I commit to choosing 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 proceeds directly to the clinic. I’ll also keep my catch to 6 tons next month for recovery, then 10 tons once the lake is back at 100. This must stay a one-month exception, with everyone following the recovery limits. John, can you commit to your share?
